definition: An underground electric railway system, especially in London.
example: I always take the tube to get across the city quickly.

definition: To help improve something or increase someone's confidence.
example: Winning the competition will give her a boost of confidence.

definition: To behave towards someone in a particular way.
example: It's important to treat all students like equals.

definition: To tie or fasten something tightly, or to be certain to do something.
example: If you study hard, you are bound to pass the exam.

definition: Something that encourages you to do something.
example: The company offered a big incentive for employees to work overtime.

definition: Turned into ice; very cold.
example: Without warm clothes in the snow, we might freeze to death.

definition: The medical procedure to end a pregnancy.
example: The patient had to have an abortion for medical reasons.

definition: Existing or happening before something else.
example: Finishing this report is a top priority before I can go home.

definition: A feeling of extreme fear.
example: The small child hid under the bed in terror of the storm.

definition: Long life or the long duration of something.
example: The company is concerned about the longevity of its new product.

definition: Full of energy and very active.
example: Her energetic approach to environmental issues highlighted the importance of renewable energy.

definition: To make sure that a law or rule is obeyed.
example: New parking rules will be strictly enforced starting next month.

definition: The most important or highest-ranking person in an organization or group.
example: The chief of police held a press conference about the recent crime.

definition: Very small in amount or degree; the least possible.
example: Luckily, the car accident resulted in only minimal damage to the vehicle.

definition: A serious accident, especially one in which a vehicle is destroyed, or the remains of a ship that has sunk.
example: Divers discovered an ancient ship wreck at the bottom of the sea.

definition: To make changes to something in order to improve it.
example: The education system needs to go through reform to meet modern demands.

definition: Very strong; having a very great degree of strength or concentration.
example: The desert sun had a high intensity, making it difficult to stay outside for long.

definition: Extremely angry.
example: She was furious at her brother for breaking her favorite mug.

definition: To make a process or system operate automatically.
example: The factory uses machines that are fully automated to produce goods quickly.

definition: To pay money to use something for a period of time.
example: We paid a daily hire charge for the bicycle during our vacation.

definition: A person who buys and sells goods, especially in large amounts.
example: In the past, a powerful merchant could control trade in an entire region.

definition: A piece of information or a story that has not been proven true, but is told from person to person.
example: Please don't spread a rumor; it might not be true and could harm someone.

definition: A formal promise that something will be done or will happen.
example: The new washing machine comes with a full guarantee for two years.

definition: A room, especially one of a special type, or a space in a machine or body.
example: The ancient tomb contained a hidden chamber filled with treasures.

definition: A heavy load, either physical or mental.
example: I don't want to burden my friends with my problems.

definition: An area that is dark and cool because the light of the sun does not reach it.
example: It was so hot that we decided to rest in the shade of a large tree.

definition: To stop someone from doing something, or to control a feeling or action.
example: She had to restrain herself from laughing during the serious meeting.

definition: To feel or show great joy or delight.
example: The whole village rejoiced when the war finally ended.

definition: To gradually get more and more of something over a period of time.
example: Dust can rapidly accumulate in a room if it's not cleaned regularly.

definition: To be similar or to match something, or to communicate by writing letters.
example: The results of the experiment should correspond to the initial hypothesis.

definition: At the same time.
example: I went to the shop; meanwhile, my brother started cooking dinner.

definition: Belonging to a high social class, or having high moral principles.
example: The story was about a knight from a noble family who fought for justice.

definition: A place in your body where two bones are connected.
example: My grandmother often complains about pain in her knee joint.

definition: To produce young, or to make a copy of something.
example: Humans have a complex reproductive system that allows them to have children.

definition: To give orders or tell someone exactly what to do, or to control something.
example: The larger company tried to dictate the terms of an agreement to the smaller one.

definition: To discuss something formally in order to reach an agreement.
example: The union will negotiate with the company for better working conditions.

definition: A way or course taken in getting from one place to another.
example: We decided to take the scenic route home to enjoy the beautiful views.

definition: Great speed, especially when done with urgency or rush.
example: In her great haste, she forgot to lock the door when she left.

definition: A person who is in the same situation, or who has the same interests.
example: I shared a taxi with a fellow traveller going to the same airport.

definition: To control the way a machine works, or to perform a surgical procedure.
example: It takes training to properly operate machinery safely.

definition: Not paying enough attention to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes or damage things.
example: Being careless can lead to accidents, so always take care.

definition: To meet someone face to face, especially in an aggressive or challenging way.
example: She decided to confront her boss about the unfair treatment.

definition: The soft part of the body between the skin and the bones, or the edible part of a fruit or vegetable.
example: The doctor examined the patient's flesh for any signs of infection.

definition: Unfriendly and aggressive, or unwilling to accept something.
example: The local residents were hostile towards the new development plan.

definition: A set of actions that is the official or accepted way of doing something.
example: The hospital explained the complex procedure for obtaining medical records.

definition: To oppose something or to try to prevent something from happening.
example: It's hard to resist unhealthy snacks, but people can show organized resistance to harmful policies.

definition: (Of a feeling or action) experienced or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.
example: Their business partnership was built on a foundation of mutual trust and shared goals.

definition: To bring something to an end, or to decide something after careful thought.
example: After a long discussion, the committee decided to conclude the meeting.

definition: To move or make something move backwards and forwards or from side to side.
example: The pendulum continued to swing back and forth rhythmically.

definition: To change from a liquid to a gas, often by heating, or to disappear.
example: The sun's heat will evaporate the water left on the pavement.

definition: A mistake or imperfection in something.
example: There was a serious flaw in the design of the bridge, causing safety concerns.

definition: To bring people or things together to form a single unit or group.
example: The new leader promised to unify a country divided by conflict.

definition: Finite: Having limits or bounds. Infinite: Without limits; endless.
example: Humans have a finite lifespan, but the universe seems infinite.

definition: Indefinite: Not exact, without fixed limits. Definite: Clearly stated or decided; certain.
example: We have an indefinite period of time, but a definite plan for the project.

definition: To manage or supervise the operation of something, or to give a drug or treatment.
example: The teachers had to administer an exam to all students at the end of the term.

definition: To announce something publicly or officially.
example: The government decided to declare a state of emergency after the earthquake.

definition: (Of a machine or device) working by itself with little or no direct human control.
example: The car has an automatic gearbox, making it easier to drive.

definition: To make an exact copy of something.
example: Scientists tried to replicate the original experiment to confirm the results.

definition: To say that you are sorry for doing something wrong or for causing a problem.
example: I need to apologize to my friend for being late.

definition: To state or show that something is true or correct.
example: We need to wait for the hotel to confirm our reservation.

definition: A valuable stone, such as a diamond or ruby, used in jewelry.
example: She wore a beautiful jewel necklace for the special occasion.

definition: To continue with an action or to move forward.
example: The lawyer explained the legal proceedings involved in the case.

definition: To get rid of something, especially by throwing it away.
example: Please dispose of all waste properly in the designated bins.

definition: A period of time during which a particular activity takes place.
example: The training session lasted for three hours.

definition: Relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, or polite and well-mannered.
example: Even if you disagree, you should always try to be civil to other people.

definition: Clean, neat, and stylish in appearance, or intelligent.
example: She looked very smart in her new suit for the interview.

definition: To create music or writing, or to form something by putting different parts together.
example: He spent hours trying to compose a beautiful song for his girlfriend.

definition: To secretly get access to a computer system or network, or a clever solution to a problem.
example: A criminal managed to hack into the company's secure database.

definition: Not as good as something or someone else.
example: This product is inferior to the one we bought last year.

definition: In a correct or suitable way.
example: He didn't behave properly in the meeting, unlike the usual proper behavior expected.

definition: A piece of cooking equipment that burns fuel or uses electricity to heat food.
example: We cooked dinner on the gas stove in the kitchen.

definition: A machine, usually with wheels, that is used for transporting people or goods.
example: Cars, buses, and trucks are all types of motor vehicle.

definition: Expected to be or happen in the future.
example: The real estate agent met with several prospective buyers for the house.

definition: Happening before a more important action or event.
example: The research is still in its preliminary stages, so no results are available yet.

definition: Moving towards a higher place or level.
example: There has been an upward trend in house prices over the last year.

definition: A lawyer, especially one who can act for clients in court.
example: My attorney advised me not to sign the contract without reading it carefully.

definition: An area of knowledge or activity, or a specific area of control.
example: After 70 years, the old novel entered the public domain, meaning anyone can use it freely.

definition: In front; in advance.
example: If you start studying now, you will be ahead of the class by next week.

definition: To take responsibility for a task or project.
example: The team decided to undertake responsibility for the entire project.

definition: To succeed in achieving something after a lot of effort.
example: She worked hard and was able to fully attain her career goals.

definition: To mention something as an example, proof, or support, or to refer to a source of information.
example: In academic writing, you must always cite your sources correctly.

definition: To show approval or praise by clapping hands.
example: The audience began to applaud loudly at the end of the play.

definition: Unable to see, or to make someone unable to see.
example: The bright headlights of the oncoming car temporarily blinds the driver.

definition: Lacking knowledge or information about a particular subject.
example: His comments showed ignorance about the local culture.

definition: A feeling of nervousness or worry, or a feeling of anger between people or groups.
example: There was a lot of tension in the room before the exam results were announced.

definition: To be disloyal to someone who trusts you, or to reveal secret information.
example: He felt betrayed when his best friend shared his secret.
